summary: Pre-check standalone ASS and SRT script on-disk byte lengths against 64 MiB and max_controlled_bytes via std::fs::metadata(source) before reading in try_convert_ass_inner and try_convert_srt_inner, check Matroska metadata working-set budget before export_atomic in owned_subtitle_burn::burn_subtitles, and add fvid::media::probe_with_options and probe_as_with_options forwarding CopyOptions to native_probe::try_probe_as_with_options and fvid_media::owned_probe::probe_with_options.
